svg.title: Ila and Vale turn Riju's confession into a public design test.
svg.desc: The anomaly notebook sits between contractor evidence, service gains and Ananya's reason log. Ila rejects automatic denial and hidden favours, while Vale challenges the room to build a system that can declare uncertainty.
